comment: Regenerated context-free Lean-to-TeX drafts for semantic statement rejudge; every visible binder/hypothesis remains part of the translated surface.

appendix_c_lemma1_item_fairness_positive.tex_statement: \forall {m n : ℕ} [NeZero m] [inst : NeZero n] (W : RecommendationModel m n), Positive \to 0 < optimalItemFairness

appendix_c_lemma2_item_fairness_lp_value.tex_statement: \forall {m n : ℕ} [inst : NeZero n] (W : RecommendationModel m n), Nonnegative \to optimalItemFairnessLPValue = optimalItemFairness

appendix_d_lemma10_midpoint_candidate.tex_statement: \forall {n : ℕ} {v : Item n \to ℝ} (j : Item n), (\forall (j : Item n), 0 < v j) \to pairShare (1 / 2) v j + pairShare (1 / 2) v (reverseItem j) = 1

appendix_d_lemma11_denominator_monotonic.tex_statement: \forall {n : ℕ} {alpha alpha' : ℝ} {v : Item n \to ℝ} {t : Item n}, 0 < alpha \to alpha < 1 \to 0 < alpha' \to alpha' < 1 \to alpha \le alpha' \to (\forall (j : Item n), 0 < v j) \to StrictlyDecreasingByIndex v \to ↑t \le ↑(reverseItem t) \to problem6ClosedDenominator alpha' v t \le problem6ClosedDenominator alpha v t

appendix_d_lemma3_unconstrained_baseline.tex_statement: \forall {m n : ℕ} [inst : NeZero m] [inst_1 : NeZero n] (W : RecommendationModel m n), Nonnegative \to RowHasPositiveItem \to optimalUserFairnessAtLevel 0 = 1

appendix_d_lemma4_problem6_structure.tex_statement: \forall {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {alpha : ℝ} {v : Item n \to ℝ} {ρ : TypePolicy 2 n} {ell : ℝ}, Problem6EqualizedBasicOptimal alpha v ρ ell \to ρ.activeTypeItemPairsCard \le n + 1

appendix_d_lemma5_problem6_closed_form.tex_statement: \forall {n : ℕ} {alpha : ℝ} {v : Item n \to ℝ} {t : Item n} {x y : Item n \to ℝ} {ell : ℝ}, 0 < alpha \to alpha < 1 \to (\forall (j : Item n), 0 < v j) \to Problem6SparseEqualized alpha v t x y ell \to ell = problem6ClosedValue alpha v t

appendix_d_lemma6_mirror_inverse_gap.tex_statement: \forall {n : ℕ} {alpha : ℝ} {v : Item n \to ℝ} (j : Item n), 0 < alpha \to alpha < 1 \to (\forall (j : Item n), 0 < v j) \to (pairShare alpha v j)⁻¹ - (1 - pairShare alpha v (reverseItem j))⁻¹ = v (reverseItem j) / v j * (1 - 2 * alpha) / (alpha * (1 - alpha))

appendix_d_lemma7_pivot_monotonicity.tex_statement: \forall {n : ℕ} [inst : NeZero n] {alpha alpha' : ℝ} {v : Item n \to ℝ} (halpha0 : 0 < alpha) (halpha1 : alpha < 1) (halpha0' : 0 < alpha') (halpha1' : alpha' < 1), alpha \le alpha' \to \forall (hpos : \forall (j : Item n), 0 < v j), ↑(problem6FirstClosedPivot alpha v halpha0 halpha1 hpos) \le ↑(problem6FirstClosedPivot alpha' v halpha0' halpha1' hpos)

appendix_d_lemma8_selected_pivot_stitchi.tex_statement: \forall {n : ℕ} [inst : NeZero n] {alpha alpha' : ℝ} {v : Item n \to ℝ} {c : Item n}, 0 < alpha \to alpha < 1 \to 0 < alpha' \to alpha' < 1 \to alpha \le alpha' \to alpha \le 1 / 2 \to alpha' \le 1 / 2 \to (\forall (j : Item n), 0 < v j) \to StrictlyDecreasingByIndex v \to ↑c = ↑(reverseItem c) \to (twoTypeReducedModel alpha v).optimalItemFairness \le (twoTypeReducedModel alpha' v).optimalItemFairness

appendix_d_lemma9_pair_share_algebra.tex_statement: \forall {n : ℕ} {alpha alpha' : ℝ} {v : Item n \to ℝ} (j : Item n), 0 < alpha \to alpha < 1 \to 0 < alpha' \to alpha' < 1 \to alpha < alpha' \to (\forall (j : Item n), 0 < v j) \to pairShare alpha v j < pairShare alpha' v j

appendix_e_lemma12_symmetrized_policy.tex_statement: \forall {n : ℕ} [inst : NeZero n] {beta : ℝ} {v : Item n \to ℝ}, (\forall (j : Item n), 0 < v j) \to \forall {ρ : TypePolicy 3 n}, (theorem4EstimatedReducedModel beta v).IsOptimalAtLevel 1 ρ \to (theorem4EstimatedReducedModel beta v).IsOptimalAtLevel 1 (theorem4SymmetrizedPolicy ρ) \land Theorem4MirrorSymmetricPolicy (theorem4SymmetrizedPolicy ρ)

appendix_e_lemma13_pivot_support.tex_statement: \forall {n : ℕ} [inst : NeZero n] {ρ : TypePolicy 3 n} {t : Item n}, Theorem4Problem11PivotSupport ρ t \to ↑theorem4FirstItem < ↑t \to (ρ 2) theorem4FirstItem = 0 \land (ρ 2) theorem4LastItem = 0

appendix_e_lemma14_uniqueness.tex_statement: \forall {n : ℕ} [inst : NeZero n] {beta : ℝ} {v : Item n \to ℝ} {ρ ρ' : TypePolicy 3 n} {ell ell' : ℝ}, 2 < n \to 0 < beta \to beta < 1 / 2 \to (\forall (l : Item n), 0 < v l) \to StrictlyDecreasingByIndex v \to Theorem4Problem11EqualizedBasicOptimal beta v ρ ell \to Theorem4Problem11EqualizedBasicOptimal beta v ρ' ell' \to ρ = ρ'

appendix_e_lemma15_closed_formula.tex_statement: \forall {n : ℕ} [inst : NeZero n] {beta : ℝ} {v : Item n \to ℝ} {ρ : TypePolicy 3 n} {ell : ℝ} {t : Item n}, 0 < beta \to (\forall (l : Item n), 0 < v l) \to Theorem4Problem11EqualizedBasicOptimal beta v ρ ell \to Theorem4Problem11PivotSupport ρ t \to ↑t < ↑(reverseItem t) \to ell = (2 * beta * pairShare (1 / 2) v t + 1 / 2 * (1 - 2 * beta)) / (1 + pairShare (1 / 2) v t * paper_lemma15_problem11_leftSum v t + 1 / 2 * (↑n - 2 * (↑↑t + 1)))

appendix_e_lemma17_no_right_half_support.tex_statement: \forall {n : ℕ} [inst : NeZero n] {beta : ℝ} {v : Item n \to ℝ} {ρ : TypePolicy 3 n} {ell : ℝ}, 2 < n \to 0 < beta \to (\forall (l : Item n), 0 < v l) \to StrictlyDecreasingByIndex v \to Theorem4Problem11EqualizedBasicOptimal beta v ρ ell \to \forall (j : Item n), ↑(reverseItem j) < ↑j \to (ρ 0) j = 0

example1_homogeneous_tradeoff_bound.tex_statement: \forall {epsilon rho1 rho2 Umin Imin : ℝ}, rho2 = 1 - rho1 \to Imin \le rho2 \to Umin \le rho1 + epsilon \to Umin + Imin \le 1 + epsilon

itemFairness.tex_statement: {m n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (W : RecommendationModel m n) (ρ : Policy m n) = EconCSLib.finiteMin (normalizedItemUtility W ρ)

itemNormalizer.tex_statement: {m n : ℕ} (W : RecommendationModel m n) (j : Item n) = \sum u, W.utility u j

normalizedItemUtility.tex_statement: {m n : ℕ} (W : RecommendationModel m n) (ρ : Policy m n) (j : Item n) = let denom = itemNormalizer W j if denom = 0 then 0 else rawItemUtility W ρ j / denom

normalizedUserUtility.tex_statement: {m n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (W : RecommendationModel m n) (ρ : Policy m n) (u : User m) = rawUserUtility W ρ u / RecommendationModel.bestItemUtility W u

priceOfFairness.tex_statement: {m n : ℕ} [NeZero m] [NeZero n] (W : RecommendationModel m n) = priceOfFairnessAt W 1

priceOfFairnessAt.tex_statement: {m n : ℕ} [NeZero m] [NeZero n] (W : RecommendationModel m n) (\gamma : ℝ) = let base = RecommendationModel.optimalUserFairnessAtLevel W 0 if base = 0 then 0 else (base - RecommendationModel.optimalUserFairnessAtLevel W \gamma) / base

priceOfMisestimation.tex_statement: {m n : ℕ} [NeZero m] [NeZero n] (E : EstimatedRecommendationModel m n) (\gamma : ℝ) (ρhat : Policy m n) = let base = RecommendationModel.optimalUserFairnessAtLevel E.trueModel \gamma if base = 0 then 0 else (base - RecommendationModel.userFairness E.trueModel ρhat) / base

proposition1_symmetric_lp_reduction.tex_statement: \forall {m n K : ℕ} [inst : NeZero m] [inst_1 : NeZero n] [NeZero K] (R : ReductionWitness m n K) (reps : TypeRepresentatives types) (\gamma : ℝ), LPReductionTarget R \gamma

proposition2_symmetric_optimum_exists.tex_statement: \forall {m n K : ℕ} [inst : NeZero m] [inst_1 : NeZero n] [NeZero K] (S : SymmetricData m n K) (reps : TypeRepresentatives types), Positive \to \exists ρsym, IsTypeSymmetric types ρsym \land IsOptimalAtLevel 1 ρsym

rawItemUtility.tex_statement: {m n : ℕ} (W : RecommendationModel m n) (ρ : Policy m n) (j : Item n) = \sum u, W.utility u j * (ρ u j).toReal

rawUserUtility.tex_statement: {m n : ℕ} (W : RecommendationModel m n) (ρ : Policy m n) (u : User m) = EconCSLib.Policy.agentScore ρ W.utility u

recommendationUtility.tex_statement: {m n : ℕ} (W : RecommendationModel m n) (u : User m) (j : Item n) = W.utility u j

solvesProblemOne.tex_statement: {m n : ℕ} [NeZero m] [NeZero n] (W : RecommendationModel m n) (\gamma : ℝ) (ρ : Policy m n) = RecommendationModel.IsOptimalAtLevel W \gamma ρ

theorem3_price_decreases_first_half.tex_statement: For the opposing two-type source model with positive strictly decreasing item values and 0 < alpha <= alpha' <= 1/2, increasing alpha toward the balanced population weakly decreases the price of fairness.

theorem3_price_increases_second_half.tex_statement: For the opposing two-type source model with positive strictly decreasing item values and 1/2 <= alpha <= alpha' < 1, increasing alpha away from the balanced population weakly increases the price of fairness.

theorem4_misestimation_tradeoff_typeOne.tex_statement: \forall {m n : ℕ} [inst : NeZero m] [inst_1 : NeZero n] (E : EstimatedRecommendationModel m n) (Rtrue : ReductionWitness m n 2) (Rest : ReductionWitness m n 3) (repsTrue : TypeRepresentatives types) (repsEst : TypeRepresentatives types) {beta eps : ℝ} (u : User m), 2 < n \to trueModel = model \to estimatedModel = model \to reduced = twoTypeReducedModel (1 / 2) (theorem4SmallValueVector eps) \to reduced = theorem4EstimatedReducedModel beta (theorem4SmallValueVector eps) \to (\forall (u : User m), toType u = 0 \to toType u = 0) \to (\forall (u : User m), toType u = 1 \to toType u = 1) \to toType u = 1 \to toType u = 2 \to 0 < eps \to (↑n)⁻¹ < beta \to beta < 1 / 2 \to (have ρ0 := theorem4NoFairnessPolicyCollapsed (theorem4SmallValueVector eps); SolvesEstimatedProblem 0 (liftedPolicy ρ0) \land priceOfMisestimation 0 (liftedPolicy ρ0) \le 1 / 2) \land \exists ρ1, SolvesEstimatedProblem 1 (liftedPolicy ρ1) \land 1 - eps < priceOfMisestimation 1 (liftedPolicy ρ1)

theorem4_misestimation_tradeoff_typeZero.tex_statement: \forall {m n : ℕ} [inst : NeZero m] [inst_1 : NeZero n] (E : EstimatedRecommendationModel m n) (Rtrue : ReductionWitness m n 2) (Rest : ReductionWitness m n 3) (repsTrue : TypeRepresentatives types) (repsEst : TypeRepresentatives types) {beta eps : ℝ} (u : User m), 2 < n \to trueModel = model \to estimatedModel = model \to reduced = twoTypeReducedModel (1 / 2) (theorem4SmallValueVector eps) \to reduced = theorem4EstimatedReducedModel beta (theorem4SmallValueVector eps) \to (\forall (u : User m), toType u = 0 \to toType u = 0) \to (\forall (u : User m), toType u = 1 \to toType u = 1) \to toType u = 0 \to toType u = 2 \to 0 < eps \to (↑n)⁻¹ < beta \to beta < 1 / 2 \to (have ρ0 := theorem4NoFairnessPolicyCollapsed (theorem4SmallValueVector eps); SolvesEstimatedProblem 0 (liftedPolicy ρ0) \land priceOfMisestimation 0 (liftedPolicy ρ0) \le 1 / 2) \land \exists ρ1, SolvesEstimatedProblem 1 (liftedPolicy ρ1) \land 1 - eps < priceOfMisestimation 1 (liftedPolicy ρ1)

userFairness.tex_statement: {m n : ℕ} [NeZero m] [NeZero n] (W : RecommendationModel m n) (ρ : Policy m n) = EconCSLib.finiteMin (normalizedUserUtility W ρ)
